insight: Released Mochi 1 in Oct 2024 under Apache 2.0; raised a $28.4M Series A led by NEA the same month.
name: Genmo
tagline: Open-source text-to-video generation, with a free hosted playground.
description: AI video startup behind Mochi 1, an open-source text-to-video model built on an Asymmetric Diffusion Transformer (AsymmDiT) architecture. The weights and code are on GitHub and Hugging Face for local or self-hosted use, while genmo.ai hosts a free playground to generate clips from prompts in the browser.

modelSupport.notes: Ships its own Mochi 1 weights; runnable locally or via the hosted playground.

edge: One of the few genuinely open (Apache 2.0) text-to-video models with downloadable weights, not just a closed hosted generator.
pros: Free hosted playground to try it
Strong motion fidelity for an open model
cons: Local runs need heavy GPU memory
Short clip lengths versus closed rivals

references.title: Genmo launches Mochi 1, an open-source rival to Runway and Kling
